narrative: 工人们，接着是一间屠宰场。这次剪辑就是一个论点。
或者：汗水、绳索、台阶、一次呼吸、后来同一段台阶、一个如今能够爬上去的身体。时间被压缩了，是这个序列完成了这次攀登。
当你需要在一分钟里塞进几个月，或者需要一个任何单一画面都无法独自承载的想法时使用它。当两个正在进行的动作必须保持同时鲜活时，这个手法就用错了——那属于交叉剪辑（Cross-Cutting）。
当你只是想在一个机位设置里跳过几秒钟时，这个手法也用错了——那是跳切（Jump Cut）。一次富有感染力的类比并不等于事实证据。
不要让这个序列暗示未经支持的真实世界因果关系。
how: 先确定你想让观众得出的推论，或者时间的曲线。选择那些关系清晰可辨的画面：用匹配的几何关系表示类比，用逐渐进阶的体型或汗水表示训练，用重复的仪式表示成瘾。
把时长当作一个可以控制的指标（不断缩短直到达到高潮，或者用一次停顿作为回报）。提示词：montage sequence built around [Subject], time collapsed by images, training, travel, or a life in twenty shots.
when: 用在训练、一段在早餐桌上逐渐消亡的婚姻、一座城市的到来，或者一篇由影像组成的散文上。不要用它来处理一场你本可以用连续叙事完成的戏。
如果观众必须逐拳逐招地跟随一场打斗，那就直接拍这场打斗。
vs: 交叉剪辑编织的是仍在继续的平行动作。蒙太奇（Montage）则常常把每个镜头作为一个单元，完成一次论证或一段人生的延时呈现。
跳切在一个机位设置里挖出一个洞。碎片化剪辑（Fragments）克扣一个事件的完整视角；蒙太奇则可能展示完整的视角，而它们的碰撞才是事件本身。
快切（Quick Cuts）是一种时长模式；当顺序开始构成一个主张时，它们就变成了蒙太奇。
examples_film: 《洛奇》（Rocky）和《功夫小子》（The Karate Kid）把训练压缩成逐步递增的劳动。《罢工》（Strike）和《十月》（October）通过碰撞画面来构建政治论点。
《公民凯恩》（Citizen Kane）把一段婚姻在一次次早餐中压缩到只剩沉默。《飞屋环游记》（Up）把一生浓缩进几个精选的瞬间。
窃取它的功能（压缩、论证），而不是那些配乐金曲。
mistakes: 最常见的误用近亲是没有任何主张的快切，或者一次单一的移动摄影。破绽是：同样五秒钟被拍成了二十个角度，或者变成了一种变形式的拼贴。
解决办法是：选定一个推论或一段时间跨度，选择彼此有区别的画面，按顺序剪辑，让这次拼接来完成工作。

faq.q: 电影中的“蒙太奇”是什么？
faq.a: 蒙太奇是由镜头的顺序所制造出的意义或压缩效果。剪接点的每一侧都是一幅画面；这个想法出现在并置之中，而不是存在于任何单一画面里。

faq.q: 蒙太奇 vs 交叉剪辑
faq.a: 交叉剪辑让两条动作线在暗示中的同时性里持续进行。蒙太奇压缩时长，或碰撞画面以形成一个主张。一个是在与时钟赛跑；另一个是在构建一个论点或一段浓缩的时光。
当你需要在一分钟里塞进几个月，或者需要一个只存在于画面之间的想法时使用。不要把它用作一堆来自同一场戏、未曾用上的素材。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写蒙太奇的提示词？
faq.a: 列出这些镜头以及要传达的主张。示例：Montage sequence built around [Subject], time collapsed by images, training, travel, or a life in twenty shots. 明确指定顺序，而不是单一的移动镜头。

narrative: Workers, then a slaughterhouse. The cut is an argument.
Or: sweat, rope, steps, a breath, the same stairs later, a body that can now climb. Time has collapsed, and the sequence did the climbing.
Use it when you need months in a minute, or an idea neither image holds alone. It is the wrong tool when two ongoing actions must remain simultaneously alive: that is Cross-Cutting.
It is the wrong tool when you only want to skip a few seconds in one setup: that is a Jump Cut. An evocative analogy is not factual proof.
Do not let the sequence imply unsupported real-world causation.
how: State the intended inference or the time curve first. Choose images whose relation is legible: matching geometry for analogy, progressive sizes or sweat for training, repeated rituals for addiction.

Control duration as a metric (shortening toward a peak, or a held pause as payoff). Prompt: montage sequence built around [Subject], time collapsed by images, training, travel, or a life in twenty shots.
when: Use it for training, a marriage dying over breakfasts, a city arriving, an essay of images. Do not use it to cover a scene you could have played in continuity.
If the audience must follow one fight blow by blow, shoot the fight.
vs: Cross-Cutting braids parallel actions that continue. Montage often finishes each shot as a unit in an argument or a time-lapse of life.
Jump Cut holes out one setup. Fragments withhold a complete view of one event; montage may show complete views whose collision is the event.
Quick Cuts are a duration pattern; they become montage when the order makes a claim.
examples_film: Rocky and The Karate Kid compress training into progressive labor. Strike and October collide images into political argument.
Citizen Kane breakfasts a marriage down to silence. Up condenses a life into selected moments.
Steal the function (compress, argue), not the needle-drops.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Quick Cuts with no claim, or a single moving camera. The tell: twenty angles of the same five seconds, or a morphing collage.
The fix: pick an inference or a time span, choose distinct images, cut on order, let the join do the work.

faq.a: Montage is meaning or compression made by the order of shots. Each side of a join is a picture; the idea appears in the juxtaposition, not in either image alone.
Cross-cutting keeps two action lines running in implied simultaneity. Montage compresses duration or collides images to make a claim. One races clocks; the other builds an argument or a month.
Use it when you need months in a minute, or an idea that only exists between images. Do not use it as a pile of unused coverage from one scene.

faq.q: How do I prompt Montage for AI image or video?
faq.a: List the shots and the claim. Example: Montage sequence built around [Subject], time collapsed by images, training, travel, or a life in twenty shots. Specify order, not a single moving take.
